$comment: Ground truth for the vitest pack (docs/packs.md, "Ground truth"). Each public repository is pinned at the commit before its own Vitest 4 to 5 upgrade. Expected findings come from two sources that are not Uptide: the diagnostics the repository's TypeScript reports with vitest at the upgrade's version linked in and not without it, and the lines the upgrade commit changed (pnpm packs:truth, read by hand). Left out on purpose: the 169 diagnostics under votingworks/vxsuite's libs/image-utils/src/vitest_setup.ts, which are evidence of that declaration (one cause, recorded once at it); renames of setup files and of eslint ignores for them, a new fsModuleCache option, removed redundant clearMocks: true opt-ins, the snapshot files renamed by the new test.each titles, jest.CustomMatcherResult becoming SyncMatcherResult (it compiles at Vitest 5), and everything in votingworks/vxsuite that is not about vitest. Paths are the ones at the pinned commit: pnpm packs:truth prints the post-rename path with the pre-rename line for a file the upgrade moved, so those were read from git diff -M by hand. siemens/element (a real Vitest 5 migration) cannot be installed from a public registry (its @simpl and @siemens-ux packages live on code.siemens.com), so it is not ground truth. votingworks/vxsuite has no entry point removals, sequential tests or nested vi.mock; those rules and notes rest on fixtures and the guide only. Expected 'matcher-types' at libs/ui/src/setupTests.ts:20 and 'bench-api' at libs/hmpb/src/render_ballot.bench.ts:16 are sites no check signal covers yet.
